code_quality.title: Extract shared SidebarNavItem component to @xala/ds package
code_quality.description: The SidebarNavItem component is nearly identical in both apps/backoffice/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx (408 lines) and apps/minside/src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx (498 lines). Both implementations have the same styling patterns, active state handling, badge display logic, and visual structure with only minor differences in props.
code_quality.rationale: Code duplication leads to maintenance burden where fixes must be applied in multiple places. As both sidebars share ~80% identical code for the nav item component, extracting to @xala/ds would ensure consistency and reduce total codebase size by ~200 lines.
code_quality.currentState: Two separate SidebarNavItem implementations with nearly identical styling, active state logic, and badge rendering. Both use the same design tokens and visual patterns but were developed independently.
code_quality.proposedChange: Create packages/ds/src/composed/sidebar-nav.tsx with a configurable SidebarNavItem component that accepts NavItem props, handles active state via react-router-dom integration, and supports badges. Both apps would import and use this shared component with app-specific navigation data.
code_quality.bestPractice: DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) - extract shared UI components into the design system package

code_quality.title: Extract messaging utilities into shared SDK utils
code_quality.description: Both apps/backoffice/src/routes/messages.tsx (951 lines) and apps/minside/src/routes/messages.tsx (916 lines) contain duplicated utility functions: formatTimeAgo(), formatMessageDate(), and getTimeAgoKey(). These time formatting utilities are used for conversation timestamps and message grouping.
code_quality.rationale: Time formatting utilities are a common need across messaging features. Having two slightly different implementations risks inconsistent behavior and requires maintaining the same logic in multiple places. The SDK already exports formatTime, so these utilities logically belong there.
code_quality.currentState: formatTimeAgo(), formatMessageDate(), and related time-relative functions are duplicated. Backoffice version returns Norwegian hardcoded strings ('Nå', 'I dag', 'I går'), while minside version attempts i18n integration but still has hardcoded fallbacks.
code_quality.proposedChange: Add formatRelativeTime(), formatMessageGroupDate(), and getRelativeTimeUnit() to packages/client-sdk/src/utils/date-utils.ts. These would return either formatted strings or keys for i18n lookup. Update both message pages to use the shared utilities.
code_quality.bestPractice: DRY principle - consolidate date/time utilities in the SDK where they can be tested, documented, and reused
prerequisites: Add relative time and duration formatters to i18n (already planned)

code_quality.title: Split ListingAvailabilityCalendar.tsx into mode-specific modules
code_quality.description: packages/ds/src/blocks/ListingAvailabilityCalendar.tsx is 1957 lines and handles three distinct calendar modes: TIME_SLOTS (week/day timeline), ALL_DAY (month view with day selection), and MULTI_DAY (date range picker). Each mode has unique rendering logic, state management, and interaction patterns bundled into one massive component.
code_quality.rationale: At nearly 2000 lines, this file violates single responsibility principle and is difficult to maintain, test, and review. The three modes are distinct enough that they could be separate components with shared utilities, improving code organization and making each mode easier to understand and modify.
code_quality.currentState: Single 1957-line component with mode-specific rendering blocks, shared types, utility functions, and CSS-in-JS styles all in one file. Contains TIME_SLOTS (week view with hourly slots), ALL_DAY (month calendar), and MULTI_DAY (date range) implementations.
code_quality.proposedChange: Split into: 1) packages/ds/src/blocks/calendar/types.ts - shared types and constants 2) packages/ds/src/blocks/calendar/TimeSlotsCalendar.tsx - TIME_SLOTS mode 3) packages/ds/src/blocks/calendar/AllDayCalendar.tsx - ALL_DAY mode 4) packages/ds/src/blocks/calendar/MultiDayCalendar.tsx - MULTI_DAY mode 5) packages/ds/src/blocks/calendar/CalendarLegend.tsx - shared legend component 6) packages/ds/src/blocks/ListingAvailabilityCalendar.tsx - thin wrapper that selects the appropriate mode component
code_quality.bestPractice: Single Responsibility Principle - each module should have one reason to change; component files should typically be 300-500 lines
prerequisites: Ensure test coverage exists before refactoring

code_quality.title: Split header-parts.tsx into individual component files
code_quality.description: packages/ds/src/composed/header-parts.tsx is 1473 lines containing 10+ distinct header subcomponents: HeaderLogo, HeaderSearch, HeaderThemeToggle, HeaderLanguageSelector, HeaderActions, HeaderUserMenu, HeaderNotificationBell, HeaderMobileMenu, HeaderLoginButton, and more. Each component has its own props interface, styles, and logic.
code_quality.rationale: The file is essentially a module dump of unrelated components. While they're all 'header parts', they serve different purposes and change for different reasons. This makes the file hard to navigate, increases merge conflict risk, and makes individual components difficult to test in isolation.
code_quality.currentState: Single 1473-line file containing HeaderLogo (50 lines), HeaderSearch (200+ lines with animation states), HeaderThemeToggle (100 lines), HeaderLanguageSelector (150 lines), HeaderActions (50 lines), HeaderUserMenu (200+ lines with dropdown), HeaderNotificationBell (100 lines), HeaderMobileMenu (200+ lines), HeaderLoginButton (70 lines), plus helper functions and types.
code_quality.proposedChange: Create packages/ds/src/composed/header/ directory with: HeaderLogo.tsx, HeaderSearch.tsx, HeaderThemeToggle.tsx, HeaderLanguageSelector.tsx, HeaderActions.tsx, HeaderUserMenu.tsx, HeaderNotificationBell.tsx, HeaderMobileMenu.tsx, HeaderLoginButton.tsx, types.ts (shared types), and index.ts (barrel export). Keep backward-compatible re-exports from header-parts.tsx.
code_quality.bestPractice: Single Responsibility Principle and file organization - each component in its own file makes the codebase easier to navigate and reduces cognitive load

code_quality.title: Convert booking-engine/styles.ts CSS-in-JS to CSS modules
code_quality.description: packages/ds/src/blocks/booking-engine/styles.ts is a 1500-line file containing CSS template strings for the UnifiedBookingEngine component. This CSS-in-JS approach creates a massive string that gets injected at runtime, hurts performance, and makes styles difficult to maintain, lint, and debug.
code_quality.rationale: CSS-in-JS template strings at this scale have several drawbacks: no syntax highlighting or linting in the string, runtime style injection overhead, difficult to identify unused styles, and no CSS module scoping. Converting to CSS modules would improve developer experience, enable IDE support, and potentially reduce bundle size through CSS minification.
code_quality.currentState: 1500 lines of CSS in a template literal string exported as unifiedBookingEngineStyles. Contains ~50 CSS classes for header, stepper, calendar, pricing, confirmation, and other booking engine sections. The style tag is injected into the component on render.
code_quality.proposedChange: Convert to packages/ds/src/blocks/booking-engine/styles.module.css (or .css if not using modules). Update the component to import and use CSS class names. This enables CSS tooling, better tree-shaking, and proper CSS minification. As an alternative, consider converting to Tailwind utility classes if the project moves in that direction.
code_quality.bestPractice: Prefer CSS files over CSS-in-JS for large style blocks - enables better tooling, IDE support, and optimization
prerequisites: Verify CSS module support in build configuration
